reason: I want to see what happens to the old orange star as the galaxies pass through each other.
expectation: The stars will move into the other galaxy's outskirts; I’m unsure what happens to the orange star itself.

alternatives.reason: The gas crossing also addresses a goal, but I want to follow the orange star first.

effect: The orange star survives in a stream, completing its goal; I’ll follow the gas next.
reaction: The contrast between changing paths and surviving stars is satisfying.
reason: The dense gas crossing seems directly relevant to where the gas goes.
expectation: I expect the crossing gases to interact and perhaps compress, though I’m unsure of the result.

alternatives.reason: The thin gas also intersects the crossing, but I expect the dense gas to show a stronger interaction.

effect: The dense gas collision compresses and heats the cloud, while cooling allows parts to gather further; the gas goal remains open.
reaction: The contrast with stars passing between one another makes the collision easier to understand.
reason: I’ll follow the thin gas through the same crossing to see how its outcome differs.
expectation: I expect the thin gas to interact with the crossing gas, though its fate may differ from the dense cloud’s.

alternatives.reason: The cloud’s destination also seems relevant, but I want to finish exploring the crossing first.

effect: The thin gas forms a hot, diffuse bridge rather than collapsing promptly; I’ll follow the remaining cloud.
reaction: The different outcomes for dense and thin gas are informative.
reason: This is the only available gameplay action, and it may show where the cloud goes.
expectation: I expect the cloud to reach the other galaxy’s outskirts, though its subsequent fate is unclear.

effect: The outer cloud avoids the main collision and is drawn outward by the other galaxy’s unequal pull, completing the gas goal.
reaction: I liked that the cloud could leave the spiral without being burned or broken.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the dense and thin gas through the crossing was most worthwhile: their contrasting outcomes made the role of density clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the outer cloud was less engaging as a decision because it was the only gameplay action left, though its result was informative.

surprise.text: The outer cloud could miss the collision entirely yet still be drawn outward with the stars.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the offered options connected to the chapter’s questions, although their precise outcomes were uncertain.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the different portions of gas develop, especially after the contrast between the dense cloud and hot bridge.
